headline: Machado is back in Venezuela, Serbia votes in record numbers, and Storm Boelo turns deadly

stories.title: María Corina Machado is back in Venezuela after ten months in exile
facts: Machado posted "I'm here. With you" on X on Sunday, her first time in Venezuela since December.
She left the country to collect her Nobel Peace Prize and spent about ten months abroad after several failed attempts to return.
She attended mass at the Divina Pastora shrine in Barquisimeto, Lara state; Edmundo González confirmed the return.
She plans to meet victims of June's twin earthquakes (at least 6,500 dead) and families of political prisoners.
The return strains ties with the Trump administration, which removed Maduro in January, and is unlikely to please interim president Delcy Rodríguez.
stories.whyItMatters: Venezuela's best-known opposition figure is now inside the country while the post-Maduro interim government is still settling who holds power.

stories.title: Serbia votes with record turnout and reports of pressure on voters
facts: Turnout hit 46% by 14:00 per the BBC, about a million more voters than in December 2023.
Monitor CRTA put turnout at 56.4% by 16:00, 14 points above 2023.
CRTA saw pressure on voters at about a third of polling stations and ballot photographing at up to 40%.
Police filed a report in Veternik over suspected vote-buying and carousel voting.
The race pits the Student List against Vučić's SNS, in power since 2012; a final Ipsos poll paid for by Vučić's list had SNS at 47.4% and the students at 40%.
stories.whyItMatters: It's the first national test of the protest movement born after the 2024 Novi Sad canopy collapse that killed 16 people.

image.alt: A woman put her hand vote into a ballot box

stories.title: Schiff wants Hegseth to testify on the Ukraine Starlink slowdown
facts: On Meet the Press, Sen. Adam Schiff said Hegseth should testify if Democrats retake the Senate.
"Somebody is lying here," Schiff said about the conflicting accounts after Musk's admission this morning.
Ukraine said Saturday that Starlink and Starshield were back at high speeds.
Sen. Blumenthal already opened a Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations inquiry with an Oct 22 letter to Hegseth.

stories.title: Storm Boelo kills a man in Scotland and cuts power to 53,000 homes
facts: A 60-year-old man died when a tree fell at Mid Kelton near Castle Douglas, Dumfries and Galloway, around 10:30.
About 53,000 Scottish homes lost power; SSEN is restoring supply.
Gusts reached 82mph on Tiree and 80mph on Islay; an amber warning runs until 21:00.
The Netherlands named it its first official storm of 2026.

stories.title: Apple's touch-screen OLED MacBook Pro is expected Wednesday
facts: Bloomberg reports Apple will unveil a touch-screen OLED MacBook Pro at its Oct 28 event.
It's expected in 14- and 16-inch sizes with M5 Pro and M5 Max chips.
A Dynamic Island replaces the notch, per the reports.
